description: $0.02 read-only endpoint preflight. Use before an agent depends on or pays an unfamiliar API, webhook or URL. Returns reachability, HTTP status, latency, risk flags and SHA-256 evidence. Rejects private/local hosts and malformed URLs; unreachable/upstream failures are returned explicitly rather than fabricated.

url.description: Public http/https endpoint URL including scheme. Private/local hosts and nonstandard ports are rejected.

name: gridwatch_preflight
